Subject: Quick follow-up on today's discovery — token volumes & thresholds

Hi Karthik / Neha,

Thanks for the call this morning — helpful to understand Redwood's routing and caching levers. A couple of quick clarifying items from our side so we can map internally: 

- Rough monthly profile: 3 patterns we expect to see in Phase 1 (pilot -> ramp):
  - Pilot (month 1): ~150k-250k tokens/day (~4.5M-7.5M tokens/month)
  - Ramp (months 2-4): ~500k tokens/day average (~15M tokens/month)
  - Steady (month 5+): spikes to ~1.2M tokens/day on peak days (~30M tokens/month avg)

- Unit-econ target: our finance lead asked what a realistic target $/1M tokens looks like when using a quantized LLM + caching. You mentioned a ballpark last week; can you provide a concrete target for discussion?

- Procurement gate: our purchasing team typically requires PO for >$25k/month spend; >$75k/month needs legal review & SaaS security evidence. Is there a recommended path to minimize friction?

We have a short internal checkpoint on Wednesday — if you can send a short cost snapshot by EOD tomorrow, that would help.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Head of Product 
FinEdge

Subject: RE: Quick follow-up on today's discovery — token volumes & thresholds

Hi Alyssa — great talking earlier. Quick recap and the numbers you asked for below. I kept this intentionally pragmatic for your procurement and finance teams.

Summary of expected monthly bands (based on the daily profiles you gave):
- Pilot: 4.5M–7.5M tokens/month
- Ramp: ~15M tokens/month
- Steady/Peak: ~30M tokens/month (with burst tolerance)

Target unit economics (typical Redwood hosted + recommended quantization + prefix caching):
- Conservative baseline: $180 — $240 per 1M tokens
- Optimized (aggressive caching + batching, dedicated pool): $95 — $140 per 1M tokens

Notes and assumptions:
- Baseline assumes mixed synchronous requests, light prompt reuse.
- Optimized assumes ~20–40% effective token savings from caching + 4x batching on steady workloads. Actual depends on prompt overlap and sequence lengths.
- We can provide a model-specific price estimate if you share a representative prompt set (small sample is sufficient).

Procurement guidance: 
- For spend < $25k/month: self-serve/standard SOW and credit card works (fastest).
- $25k–$75k/month: PO route; legal review usually lightweight (standard T&Cs).
- > $75k/month: PO + legal + security evidence (SOC2/SLA) — we can pre-bundle the SOC2 summary and security checklist to speed review.

Action items / next steps (what I'll deliver):
1) Short cost snapshot (2-slide PDF) mapping your three bands to monthly $ estimates and expected unit $/1M (deliver by EOD tomorrow).
2) Attach SOC2 executive summary and a one-tab token estimate spreadsheet.
3) Quick checklist for procurement: recommended PO language and suggested SLA uplift options.

If those assumptions look reasonable, I will send the attachments and the 2-slide cost snapshot tomorrow morning.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--

Alyssa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Deliverables attached and next steps below.

Attached: 
- Redwood-Token-Estimate.xlsx (one-tab): maps your Pilot / Ramp / Steady bands to monthly $ ranges for both Conservative and Optimized profiles.
- SOC2-summary.pdf: 1-page executive summary of our current controls for procurement/security review.

Highlights from the snapshot (high level):
- Pilot (4.5–7.5M tokens/month): $900 — $1,800/month (conservative); $430 — $1,050/month (optimized)
- Ramp (~15M/month): $2,700 — $3,600/month (conservative); $1,425 — $2,100/month (optimized)
- Steady (~30M/month avg): $5,400 — $7,200/month (conservative); $2,850 — $4,200/month (optimized)

Pilot-credit suggestion: we typically offer an evaluation credit (one-time) tied to the pilot that covers ~50% of pilot spend up to $10k, plus a short performance SLA for latency targets during the pilot. This helps validate the optimized line without a long-term commit.

Procurement path recommendation:
- Proceed via PO for the Pilot (estimated < $25k) to keep legal overhead minimal.
- If your ramp path looks likely to exceed $30k/month, open legal/security pre-review in parallel (we can provide the SOC2 packet and a short vulnerability scan summary).

Requested from your side:
- Confirm whether you want the pilot credit + we will issue a provisional quote/statement of work (I can route a PO-friendly SOW).
- Share the anonymized prompt sample (you mentioned ~200 lines) for a model-specific quote — send to sales-ops@redwood.com or upload to the secure link below.

Next steps: 
1) I will open a HubSpot opportunity record for DEAL-8241 and attach the estimate + SOC2 (link below).
2) If you agree to the pilot credit, I'll route a provisional SOW and a vendor packet for procurement.

Links: HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/DEAL-8241 
Secure upload: https://redwood-secure-upload.com/DEAL-8241-prompts

Thanks again — happy to jump on a 20-min procurement sync with your finance team if that helps unblock the PO.

Best,
Karthik
